title: No Sign of Strong Molecular Gas Outflow in an Infrared-bright Dust-obscured Galaxy with Strong Ionized-gas Outflow
question: Does an IR-bright DOG with a strong ionized-gas ([O III]) outflow also show a strong molecular (CO) gas outflow?

what.value: [OIII] velocity offset and dispersion, systemic redshift from SDSS spectrum

evidence.quote: Its $v_{\rm [OIII]}$ and $\sigma_{\rm [OIII]}$ are $-1485.0 \pm 207.7$ km s$^{-1}$ and $986.9 \pm 146.6$ km s$^{-1}$, respectively

what.value: Comparison ULIRG sample on SFR-M* plane

evidence.loc: 3.2 The stellar mass and star formation rate relation
evidence.quote: those of ULIRGs at $0 < z < 0.5$ presented by (cite: Kilerci) are also shown in Figure [4]
The relation for local IR galaxies at $z < 0.1$ reported by (cite: Kamenetzky) is also plotted.

recipe.method: Pipeline calibrated data, continuum subtraction in line-free velocity ranges, CLEAN imaging with Briggs weighting

recipe.goal: Measure line and continuum fluxes and moment maps
recipe.method: 2-D Gaussian fitting without sigma clipping; moment 0 and 1 maps

recipe.goal: Fit line profiles for outflow wings
recipe.method: Single Gaussian fit to spectra in 1" diameter apertures; check for broad wing with FWHM>500 km/s

recipe.goal: SED fitting for M*, L_IR, L_FIR, SFR
recipe.method: SEABASs SED fitting with 12 photometric points including ALMA continuum; SFR from L_IR(SF)

recipe.goal: Derive CO luminosities, r42, gas and dust masses
recipe.method: Solomon & Vanden Bout relation for L'CO; M_gas = alpha_CO/r21 * L'CO(2-1); dust mass from SED flux at 850 um

recipe.goal: Upper limit on broad CO(2-1) outflow component
recipe.method: 3-sigma upper limit from spectrum rms assuming unresolved broad component with FWHM 1000 km/s

evidence.loc: 3.2 The stellar mass and star formation rate relation

evidence.quote: We found that the luminosity ratio of CO(4–3) and CO(2–1) lines ($r_{\rm 42}$) to be 0.61 $\pm$ 0.07.
The estimated $M_{\rm gas}$/$M_{\rm dust}$ of WISE1029 is 53
We obtained the broad CO (2–1) line flux is $<$ 0.02 Jy km s$^{-1}$

not_stated_but_needed: Cell size, image size, clean threshold, masks and channel width of the cubes
Whether robust=2 was used for both bands and the CASA version
Aperture/fit details for continuum and line flux (2-D Gaussian parameters)
Broad-component noise rms and spectral binning used for the upper limit
SED photometry list, templates and priors used in SEABASs
Rest frequencies used for L'CO and observed frequencies
missing_for_reproduction: Cell/image size, clean parameters, CASA version
Aperture and noise details for upper limit
score_reason: Public data and simple analysis, but imaging and SED details are incomplete.
rediscovery_reason: Data public, simple numeric results (fluxes, FWHM, r42, luminosities) can be redone, though some settings are missing.
